हल [हल् घञर्थे करणे क]
1 A plough;
[]
वहसि वपुषि विशदे वसनं जलदाभम् ।
हलहतिभीतिमिलितयमुनाभम्; or हलं कलयते

.
--2 Deformity, ugliness.
--Comp.
--आयुधः an epithet of
Balarāma.
--धर, --भृत् m. {1} a
ploughman. {2} N. of Balarāma; केशव
धृतहलधररूप जय जगदीश हरे

.
--भूतिः, --भृतिः f. ploughing,
agriculture, husbandry.
--हतिः f. {1}
striking or drawing along with a
plough. {2} ploughing.

1 A female friend.
--2 The
earth.
--3 Water.
--4 Spirituous
liquor. --ind. A vocative particle
used in addressing a female friend;
(only in theatrical language); हला
शकुंतले अत्रैव तावन्मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ Ś. 1;
cf. हंडा also.

हालहली, हाला Wine, spirituous
liquor; हित्वा हालामभिमतरसां
रेवतीलोचनांकां

1 A large plough.
--2 A
furrow.
--3 Agriculture.

हलिन् m.
1 A ploughman, an
agriculturist.
--2 Balarāma.
--Comp.
--प्रियः the Kadamba tree.
--(या)
spirituous liquor.

हालिनी A kind of large
houselizard.
हलीषा The handle of a plough.

हल्य a.
1 Arable, to be ploughed.
--2 Ugly, deformed.
--ल्यं
1 A
ploughed field.
--2 Deformity,
ugliness.

हलाहः A spotted or variegated
horse.

1 = हाल(ला) हल.
--2 A
kind of snake.
--3 A sort of lizard.

हाल(ला)हलं
1 A sort of
deadly poison produced at the
churning of the ocean; (being of a
very virulent character it began
to burn up everything when it was
swallowed by the god Śiva);
अहमेव गुरुः सुदारुणानामिति हालाहल मास्म
तात दृष्यः । ननु संति भवादृशानि भूयो
भुवनेऽस्मिन् वचनानि दुर्जनानां Subhāṣ.
--2 (Hence) A deadly poison or
poison in general; see

हल्लनं Rolling or tossing about
(as in sleep.)

हल्लीशं(षं)
1 One of the 18
Uparūpakas or minor dramatic
compositions; described as a piece
in one act and consisting mainly
of singing and dancing by one
male and seven, eight, or ten
female performers; see S.

हल्लीशं(षं)
1 One of the 18
Uparūpakas or minor dramatic
compositions; described as a piece
in one act and consisting mainly
of singing and dancing by one
male and seven, eight, or ten
female performers; see S.

हालः [हलो अस्त्यस्य अण्, हल एव
वा अण्]
1 A plough.
--2 N. of
Balarāma.
--3 N. of Śālivāhana.
--Comp.
--भृत् m. an epithet of
Balarāma.

हालकः A horse of a
yellowishbrown colour.

हालहली, हाला Wine, spirituous
liquor; हित्वा हालामभिमतरसां
रेवतीलोचनांकां

1 A kind of insect.
--2
A kind of lizard.
--ला A small
mouse.
--ली Spirituous liquor.
--लं
1 = हालहल (1).
--2 Spirituous
liquor.

हालिकः [हलेन खनति हलः प्रहरणमस्य
तस्येदं वा ठक् ठञ् वा]
1 A ploughman,
an agriculturist.
--2 One that draws
a plough (as a plough-ox).
--3
One who fights with a plough.
